body.acceptance_criteria: SPEC_V2 §12 T7: triage, an approved mitigation with a read-back, resolution with a linked postmortem, a destructive call without the tenant's approvals refused, restart/scale/rollback/flag-flip callable. Proven by the executed suite with the transcript.
body.assignment: The T7 slice (SPEC_V2 §12) under the programme's architecture governance: operate the estate through one governed action surface.
body.responsibilities: The operator job requests and acts; the approver job decides every gate and is never its requester; the programme architect owns the contract and the Phase-G review.
body.scope: incidents and triage, the four write verbs, the tenant approval policy and quorum, mitigation and resolution with a postmortem, host registration and the k8s reads, and the systemic-finding loop.
